item_description_text:
A Tortilla is a flat circlular bread made from corn or flour. Tortillas are unleavened, which means that they don't have little bubbles in them like most breads.
Today, Tortillas are used in tacos, tostadas, and other common Mexican dishes.

Wikipedia
Tortillas were first invented in Central America, which is where modern countries like Mexico, Guatamala, & Nicaragua are. They made tortillas from corn, which they'd been cultivating since the 6th millennium bc. Later, flour tortillas were invented in the 1600s when wheat was introduced to the Americas.
